Q: How to properly respond to App Review rejection in AppStore connect A:

If you only changed the Age Rating metadata:

✅ Respond in Resolution Center
❌ Do NOT upload new build
❌ Do NOT press Add to Review again

You will not go to the back of the queue.

Q: Unable to get SSL and HTTP Protocol Types Using Alamofire A:

Those fields are empty, They are often nil by design. Apple does not guarantee that:

metric.negotiatedTLSProtocolVersion
metric.networkProtocolName

will be populated. These fields are optional, privacy-restricted, implementation-dependent and not always exposed to apps. Even if tools like Proxyman can see them. Proxyman works because it installs a trusted root certificate, it performs a MITM proxy, It sees the full TLS handshake but your app does not.

Alamofire is correctly forwarding the metrics from URLSession. If fields are empty, they are empty at system level. You can confirm by testing pure URLSession without Alamofire result will be the same.

There is no guaranteed way on iOS to always retrieve TLS version and HTTP protocol version from URLSession metrics. Sometimes you get them. Sometimes you don't. This is expected behavior.

Q: Insert a new row only if a row with the same subset of values doesn't exist yet A:

Solutions include:

  • Use SELECT to for the presence of the row first, then based on the result, write code to conditionally use either INSERT or UPDATE. Be careful of race conditions.

  • Try the INSERT, use a trigger to abort the insert if the row exists, catch that exception in your app, and in the exception handler run the UPDATE.

  • Change your data model so user_id has a unique constraint. For example, I'd make a compound unique constraint on user_id combined with the preference type.

You've claimed that this isn't possible using the phrase "various reasons" but we have no idea what that means. Please be specific about the reasons, and explain why you can't change these reasons.
